result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders.

The fix is one added condition, `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, in the subquery of `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`. It's the same filter the per-quarter purchase-order reports use. The outer query is unchanged, so reps with no purchase orders in the period still show 0, and the ordering is the same.

I ran the `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCount*` tests and they pass. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case, so the Anna/Bob example from your description isn't covered by one.
